args.title: Use PUBLIC_URL instead of localhost in password reset email links
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently uses a hardcoded localhost URL (`http://localhost:3000`) when `PUBLIC_URL` is not set. This causes the reset link to fail for users outside the development environment. The fix is to rely entirely on `process.env.PUBLIC_URL`, removing the fallback to localhost, so the URL matches the production deployment.
